description: Moving gently , keeps you in the present moment. #softlife #selflove #selfmastery
transcript: I've learned to move with stillness and ease and that keeps me set in this present moment. I am not focused on a future that does not exist. The most important moment is right now and the more that I move in flexibility, I move away from judgment. I don't try to force myself in one direction or another. I allow myself to move with ease with flexibility in order to get to the other side. I am not hard-pressed about this moment. It should be fun. It should be enjoyable no matter what the experience is. I control how I react.
